title: Pioneer Incentive Pool terms are incorporated by reference to the ecosystem-level Primitive rather than restated per Agent
content:
The Plasma Instance's Pioneer Incentive Pool has exactly two children. One is an address (A.6.1.1.7.2.5.3.2.1.1.2.1). The other, Terms (A.6.1.1.7.2.5.3.2.1.1.2.2), states that the Pool "is governed by the terms specified in A.2.2.9.3.1.4 - Pioneer Incentive Pool" — a document in the ecosystem-level Primitive definition, not in the Osero Artifact.

This is incorporation by reference, and it does real work. What an Agent's Instance may specify is reduced to the particulars — which network, which address — while the substantive rules stay in one place for every Agent using the Primitive. Terms cannot drift Agent by Agent through independently drafted copies.

It also changes who controls the rules. Because the terms live in the Sky Core Atlas rather than in the Osero Artifact, they are outside the reach of Osero's Root Edit process. OSERO token holders can vote to change which chain the Instance targets; they cannot vote to change what the Pool does. The Artifact Edit Restrictions at A.6.1.1.7.2.2.2.2.1.2.1.6 close the workaround, since an edit contradicting the Atlas's Primitive specifications is prohibited outright.

The generalizable reading rule: where an Instance's Parameters point outward, the Agent is a *user* of the mechanism; where they state values inline, the Agent is a *configurer* of it.
description: Osero's Instance sets only identity and address; A.6.1.1.7.2.5.3.2.1.1.2.2 points at A.2.2.9.3.1.4 for the governing terms, so no Agent can quietly hold different ones.
